hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git (add|commit|restore|clean|pull|merge|rebase|stash)( |$)|^git reset.*--hard|^git checkout( --| \.)|^git push.*(-f |--force)|^git branch.*(-d|-D)|^git tag'; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Blocked by project policy: dangerous git command. Run git operations manually in the terminal."}'; exit 1; fi
